nodes.name: Fetch Transactions
nodes.notes: 10-day lookback window. Overlap is free because the upsert is idempotent on transactionId, and it self-heals any missed run.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO fin.transactions
  (id, account_id, booked_on, amount, currency, counterparty, description, is_internal, raw)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, $3::date, $4::numeric, $5, $6, $7, $8::boolean, $9::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Upsert Txn
nodes.notes: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING = idempotency. RETURNING tells us which rows are genuinely new.

parameters.query:
UPDATE fin.accounts
   SET balance = NULLIF($1,'')::numeric,
       balance_at = now(),
       last_synced = now()
 WHERE id = $2;

-- Layer 1: deterministic rules. Runs first, costs nothing.
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.id) t.id AS txn_id, r.id AS rule_id, r.category_id
    FROM fin.transactions t
    JOIN fin.rules r
      ON (t.counterparty ILIKE r.pattern OR t.description ILIKE r.pattern)
   WHERE t.category_id IS NULL
   ORDER BY t.id, r.priority ASC
)
UPDATE fin.transactions t
   SET category_id = m.category_id, categorized_by = 'rule', confidence = 1.00
  FROM matched m
 WHERE t.id = m.txn_id
RETURNING t.id;

SELECT t.id, t.counterparty, t.description, t.amount
  FROM fin.transactions t
 WHERE t.category_id IS NULL AND NOT t.is_internal
 LIMIT 25;

nodes.name: Ollama Classify
nodes.notes: host.docker.internal reaches Ollama on the Windows host from inside the n8n container. temperature 0 + format:json keeps it parseable.

nodes.name: Parse LLM
nodes.notes: IMPORTANT for handoff: pair each Ollama response back to its txn id. Simplest fix is to carry _txn_id through the HTTP node via a Set node before Ollama Classify.

parameters.query:
UPDATE fin.transactions
   SET category_id = (SELECT id FROM fin.categories WHERE name = $2),
       categorized_by = 'llm',
       confidence = $3::numeric
 WHERE id = $1;

-- Promote confident, repeated LLM guesses into deterministic rules.
-- After a few weeks Ollama stops being called for everyday merchants.
INSERT INTO fin.rules (pattern, category_id, priority, created_by)
SELECT '%' || lower(trim(t.counterparty)) || '%', t.category_id, 50, 'llm_promoted'
  FROM fin.transactions t
 WHERE t.categorized_by = 'llm' AND t.confidence >= 0.8
   AND length(trim(coalesce(t.counterparty,''))) > 3
 GROUP BY lower(trim(t.counterparty)), t.counterparty, t.category_id
HAVING count(*) >= 3
   AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM fin.rules r
      WHERE r.pattern = '%' || lower(trim(t.counterparty)) || '%'
   );

nodes.name: Promote Rules
nodes.notes: Self-improving loop: the LLM bill shrinks over time instead of growing.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT string_agg(format('%s %s/%s EUR (%s%%)', name, round(spent), round(budget), pct), E'\n')
     FROM fin.v_month_by_category WHERE pct >= 85)                       AS over_budget,
  (SELECT string_agg(format('%s due in %s d (%s EUR)', label, days_left, coalesce(amount::text,'?')), E'\n')
     FROM fin.v_reminders_open WHERE urgent)                             AS due_soon,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fin.transactions WHERE category_id IS NULL)      AS uncat,
  (SELECT round(spent) FROM fin.v_month_summary)                         AS spent,
  (SELECT round(budget_total) FROM fin.v_month_summary)                  AS budget;

VALUES ($1, $2::int, $3::int, TRUE);

SELECT label, consent_expires, (consent_expires - CURRENT_DATE) AS days
  FROM fin.accounts
 WHERE active AND consent_expires IS NOT NULL
   AND consent_expires - CURRENT_DATE <= 7;

nodes.name: Consent Expiring?
nodes.notes: PSD2 consent dies after 90 days and the sync silently returns nothing. This is the single most likely way the pipeline breaks. Warn a week ahead.
